doc: width / (2 pi min_texels): the highest noise frequency (cycles per radian) a width-W map resolves with at least min_texels texels per wavelength, 15 rows: widths 0 (gives 0), 1 .. 1e9, min_texels 0.25 .. 8 and the default 4, one negative min_texels (sign carried through). Every row passes min_texels explicitly (the rows with 4 just happen to equal the default): the default itself is pinned by map_max_frequency.defaults. Closed-form float64: rtol 1e-9.
